svg.title: The arsenal — interface, engine and foundations
svg.desc: Three modules of tools: interface (Angular, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3), engine (C#, .NET, Java, Spring Boot, NestJS, Node.js), foundations (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker, Jenkins, Git, GitHub), plus SignalR, OpenAI API, Entity Framework, Playwright, GitLab CI and design systems.
svg.text: the stack changes, the obsession stays.

g.text: clean architecture · APIs · real-time with SignalR
data modelling · containers · ship small, ship often
